description: Restores an old, scratched or faded photo with an AI image model (Cloudflare Workers AI, img2img). Returns a new image; it does not recover lost detail or identify people. Send the photo as base64. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

image.description: Base64 of a JPEG or PNG, up to 1 MB

strength.description: How much the model may change the photo, 0.1 to 0.9 (default 0.4)
